decisions.reason: As a burner component built directly on the firm's core radiant-heater knowledge, installed base and service routines, it is still easier to improve and absorb than to discontinue, although its narrower role leaves some portfolio-pruning risk.

The electric halogen infrared heater remains related enough to the firm's infrared expertise to justify continued learning, but after the withdrawal of the panel-heater line its weaker strategic centrality makes it the most exposed of the remaining products.

This industrial electric infrared hall-heater line fits the firm's application knowledge in large non-residential spaces very closely, so feedback can be translated into incremental improvement rather than exit.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is highly compatible with the firm's existing combustion and radiant-heating know-how and with its stated hydrogen-ready direction, making continued commercialization very likely.
